_comment: One source for every fact that appears on more than one page: experience, the centres, timings and fee.
Edit a value here, run python tools/build_site.py, and every page that shows it changes.
Never retype one of these facts into a page: use its {{placeholder}} instead (see PLACEHOLDERS in
tools/build_site.py for the key each one maps to).
"pending" lists the facts still waiting on a decision, against the row in the Decisions tab of the
tracker. Values here are what the site publishes today, so the preview reads correctly either way.
An empty value means we have nothing to publish yet; the build prints those so they are not forgotten.
When a decision lands: set the value, delete its line from "pending", rebuild.
